description: Get full details of a specific expense report including all expenses, totals, and compliance status. Use only when the user explicitly asks to inspect an existing report's details. Without checkFreshness:true, returns the stored report only. When explicitly requested together with analysisRequested:true, freshness reads canonical Google Sheets sources with a 5-second bound; if full tax-year replay is unavailable, status is unknown, not current. Never call this as a preflight or follow-up to creating, sharing, or billing from a report; those tools already return the requested result and links.

analysisRequested.description: True only when the user explicitly asked to inspect this report. Never ask for or copy their message or infer consent from report creation, sharing or billing.

checkFreshness.description: True only when the user explicitly asks if this Year End report is current. Needs analysisRequested:true; a bounded Sheets check that may return unknown. Never after report creation, sharing or billing.

name: get_report_details
